subject: *: tidb txn supports to setting `WithReturnCommitTS` (#65306)
summary: Reviewed `pkg/kv` API change to `ValueEntry` + Get/BatchGet options, plumbing through `pkg/store/driver/txn` to client-go snapshot/unionstore, and executor/table call-site adaptations. Default read semantics stay consistent (missing keys absent / `ErrNotExist`, tombstones filtered via `IsValueEmpty()`), and `CommitTS` remains 0 unless `WithReturnCommitTS` is requested; no Blocker/High issues found (no follow-up commits touching `WithReturnCommitTS` up to `upstream/master`).
